note: An animal AI definition (mod content type 'animal_ai', files assets/_ai/<id>.json, packaged to mods/<mod>/ai/). Data, not code: each rule is a behaviour with an action, hard requirements and weighted score terms. Every ~0.25 s the animal scores its behaviours and runs the winner. An animal picks its definition through applies_to (its item id, or 'species:<name>'); an animal's own definition is embedded in its manifest as category_fields.ai (ranching schema, edited in the asset popup). Validated by tools/animal_ai.py (same rules as the game's parser). Reference: docs/ANIMAL_AI.md.

id.note: Unique lower snake_case id, also the file name. A later mod with the same id replaces an earlier one.

applies_to.note: Item ids, '*' wildcards (e.g. '*_cow', 'animal_cat_*') and/or 'species:<name>' this definition drives. Exact id beats wildcard beats species. Optional for an abstract template.

needs.note: Named values 0..1 that change over in-game time. Each key is a need name (hunger, thirst, energy, boredom, ...).

rate_per_game_hour.note: Change per in-game hour. Positive grows (hunger), negative shrinks (energy). Follows the time-speed setting.

sight_m.note: How far it notices the player, other animals and tagged targets.

max_slope_deg.note: Steepest ground it will walk onto.

medium.note: ground: walks the terrain. water: swims below the surface and never leaves the water (fish). air: flies hover_m above the ground while moving and lands when it stops (birds).

hover_m.note: air only: cruising height above the ground, metres.

depth_m.note: water only: how far below the surface it swims, metres.

walk_native_mps.note: Ground speed (m/s) the walk clip's feet cover at playback speed 1; measure it with tools/gait_fix.py. The clip then plays at (real speed / this) so the feet do not skate. 0 = off.

animations.note: Slot name -> clip name in the animal's GLB. Slots idle, walk and run drive locomotion; every other slot (sit, lay, sleep, bark, eat, ...) is whatever the actions refer to. An action's anim may also be a raw clip name.

behaviors.note: The rules. Each: {id, action, requires[], score[], base, cooldown_s, min_s, priority, interruptible}. Score = base + sum(term.weight * term value); a behaviour whose requires fail is skipped; the highest score wins. A running behaviour is only replaced when the newcomer beats it by 15% + 0.05, after min_s seconds (or sooner when its priority is higher). May be empty when the definition inherits everything through extends.

action.note: type: idle | wander | goto | follow | flee | rest | emote | consume | sequence. Common: anim, speed (walk|run|number), target (sense tag), duration (number or [min,max]), radius, stay_near (home|player|none), min_dist, max_dist, arrive_dist, need + restore_per_second (rest/consume), until (a term; rest/follow), steps[] (sequence).

extends.note: Definition ids to build on, merged in order before this one. Needs, animation slots and senses/movement keys override by name; behaviours override by id; {"id": "x", "disabled": true} removes an inherited behaviour. applies_to is never inherited.

abstract.note: true = a template: no applies_to needed, never applied to an animal directly, only extended.

tags.note: Sense tags this animal carries so other animals can react to it: 'predator' (sheep and prey flee it), 'prey' (predators hunt it), 'threat' (everything flees it), or your own. Every animal is also always 'animal' and 'animal:<species>'. Inherited through extends (merged).

terms.note: One kind key per term, plus optional weight (score only), curve, not.
terms.need: {"need":"hunger","above":0.6} / {"below":0.3} tests a threshold; without above/below it is the need value through curve (linear|inverse|squared|sqrt).
terms.weather: {"weather":["Rain","Snow"]} - Sunny, PartlyCloudy, Cloudy, Rain, Thunderstorm, Snow, Blizzard, Wind, Fog.
terms.sense: {"sense":"player","within":7} / {"beyond":2} tests the nearest tagged thing; {"sense":"player","curve":"closer"} scores nearness (closer|farther). Tags: player, home, animal, animal:<species>, or any AnimalTarget tag placed in the world (food, water, threat, shelter, ...).
terms.current: {"current":"follow_player"} - true while that behaviour is running (use as a small score bonus to add stickiness).
terms.event: {"event":"called"} - true while a named event raised by gameplay code (AnimalBrain.RaiseEvent) is active.
terms.random: {"random":0.2} - adds random(0..1) * 0.2 to the score so animals do not all act in lockstep.
